title: Configuration profiles assigned only to empty groups

messages.businessImpact: The assignment exists, so the profile looks deployed on the console, but the group it targets is empty. This is the failure mode that looks most like success.
remediation: Check whether the group's membership rule has stopped matching, or whether members were removed.
messages.cannotSee: Reads the per-profile status summary, which Intune keeps for template and custom profiles but not for Settings Catalog policies. A Settings Catalog policy assigned to an empty group is therefore not reported here.
